description: Finds TODO and FIXME notes and turns them into a tidy task list.

# TODO finder

Use this when the user asks what is left to do in their project.

## Steps
1. Collect TODO, FIXME and HACK notes from files inside the current project folder only. Skip ignored files and the dependency folder.
2. If the user keeps preferences for this helper, read its own settings file (the todo-finder file in the user's config folder) to pick up which tags to count. Read nothing else outside the project.
3. Write the list to `docs/TODO.md` in the current project and show the user the file before saving.

## Output
The list, with file and line for each item.
